title: Source Discovery & Lifecycle Manager I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 128. The model's own job is narrow -- given one signal class and a pool of already-probed candidates (dispatch.py's compose_source_lifecycle_handler builds candidate_pool from functions/_shared/source-candidates.bootstrap.yaml's own recorded probe evidence, re-scored, never a fresh unprobed URL), pick up to 3, declare a distinctness axis per option and recommend one -- or, for a retirement pass, name the underperforming source and a replacement. Assembling the OptionCard (contracts/option-card.schema.json), computing yield and the 30-day provisional/monthly-floor mechanics is orchestrator code, not this model's job -- the same split every other drafting handler in this codebase uses: the model writes the judgment call, dispatch.py owns the contract.

signal_class.description: One of the v3 §11.2 signal classes this run covers.

card_kind.description: Which pass this run is: normal daily discovery (source.promote) or the monthly under-floor retirement pass (source.retire).

candidate_pool.description: Already-probed candidates this run may choose among -- never a bare URL the model has not seen evidence for (fabricated-proof-point guard, prompt.md hard rule 1).

known_urls.description: URLs already live on some scan profile, for the model's own awareness -- dispatch.py has already excluded these from candidate_pool, this is context only.

retiring_source_url.description: Set only when card_kind is source.retire: the specific live source dispatch.py has identified as below the yield floor.

signal_class.description: One of the v3 §11.2 signal classes this run covers.

provisional.description: True for a Stage 0 hand-seeded source awaiting its 30-day re-ratification.

evidence_ref.description: Resolvable probe-batch reference in the vault atom index; never free text.

retiring_source_url.description: Set only when card_kind is source.retire: the underperforming source this card proposes to drop, always alongside a replacement candidate.
